spl_product_data_elements: Topcare Antacid Calcium calcium carbonate ADIPIC ACID DEXTROSE, UNSPECIFIED FORM FD&C BLUE NO. 1 FD&C RED NO. 40 MAGNESIUM STEARATE MALTODEXTRIN STARCH, CORN SUCRALOSE CALCIUM CARBONATE CALCIUM CATION CARBONATE ION L881 assorted berry
active_ingredient: Active ingredient (per tablet) Calcium Carbonate USP 1000mg
indications_and_usage: Uses relieves heartburn acid indigestion sour stomach upset stomach associated with these symptoms
ask_doctor_or_pharmacist: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
when_using: When using this product do not take more than 7 tablets in 24 hours if pregnant do not take more than 5 tablets in 24 hours do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks except under the advice and supervision of a doctor
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 12 years of age and over: chew 2-3 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor do not take for symptoms that persist for more than 2 weeks unless advised by a doctor
storage_and_handling: Other information each tablet contains: elemental calcium 400mg store at room temperature. Keep the container tightly closed.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients adipic acid, dextrose, FD&C blue #1 lake, FD&C red #40 lake, flavors, magnesium stearate, maltodextrin, starch, sucralose.
questions: Questions? 1-888-423-0139 Do Not Use Do not use if printed seal under cap is torn or missing
do_not_use: Do Not Use Do not use if printed seal under cap is torn or missing
